context: Daichi tells Mei about his shop opening.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: shop chat; vocabulary (死ん/限定/サイズ/詳しく/オープン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 来週、新しい店をオープンするんよ!
lines.en: I'm opening a new shop next week!
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: おめでとうございます!詳しく聞きたいです。
lines.en: Congratulations! I want to hear the details.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: オープン記念で、限定の品を出すんや。
lines.en: For the opening, I'll offer limited items.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: サイズは、選べるんですか?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いろんなサイズを、用意しとるで。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 準備で、忙しくて死にそうですか?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 忙しくて死にそうやけど、楽しいで!
lines.en: I'm swamped to death, but it's fun!
lines.style: enthusiastic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: オープン日、詳しく教えて下さいね。
lines.en: Please tell me the opening day in detail.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
